messages.author: 9349b31ec7c243b2
messages.subject: Warning when loading libraries
parts:
library(shiny)
library(shinyGlobe)
library(shinysky)
library(rCharts)

after upgrading I get the following warning message:
Warning in validateSelected(selected, choices, inputId) :
  'selected' must be the values instead of names of 'choices' for the input 'input_method'

Also, my download of files stopped working. Anybody else see this?

Thanks,
D.

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Warning when loading libraries
parts:
Please take a look at your input with the id "input_method", and
change the `selected` argument. As the warning message indicated,
`selected` must be the values instead of names. For example, if
choices=c(a = 1, b = 2), selected must be 1 or 2, instead of "a" or
"b".

Regards,
Yihui
